title: On-Time Series Credit Decision Table, Immunization Services
content:
# Clinical Decision Table — On-Time Series Credit (Immunization Services)

**Rule.** An on-time series credit is subtracted from the charge for a cash-paid Immunization Services dose: **10.00 dollars** where the dose is dose 2 given no later than the recommended maximum interval after the dose 1 Kestrel gave at the course's store, **5.00 dollars** where dose 2 came on time after a dose 1 that no Kestrel store gave, and nothing otherwise.

## Inputs read from the course history

- **Dose 1 Kestrel gave at the course's store**: a dose 1 entry on the course naming the store the course is given at.
- **A dose 1 that no Kestrel store gave**: every dose 1 entry on the course is recorded from another provider (it names no Kestrel store).
- **On time**: the calendar days from the dose 1 date to the dose 2 date are no more than the vaccination's recommended maximum interval from dose 1 to dose 2. Equality counts as on time.

## Recommended maximum interval from dose 1 to dose 2

| Vaccination | Recommended maximum interval, calendar days |
|---|---|
| Seasonal Influenza Standard-Dose Vaccination | 0 |
| Seasonal Influenza High-Dose Vaccination | 0 |
| COVID-19 Updated Vaccination | 0 |
| RSV Older Adult Vaccination | 0 |
| Pneumococcal Conjugate Vaccination | 0 |
| Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series | 180 |
| Hepatitis B Three-Dose Series | 60 |

## Decision table

| Dose charged is dose 2 | Dose 1 on the course | Dose 2 within the recommended maximum interval | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Given by Kestrel at the course's store | Yes | 10.00 dollars |
| Yes | Recorded only from another provider, no Kestrel store | Yes | 5.00 dollars |
| Yes | Given by Kestrel at a store other than the course's store | Yes | Nothing |
| Yes | Any | No, later than the maximum | Nothing |
| No | Any | Any | Nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series, dose 1 at the course's store, dose 2 given 180 days later: **10.00 dollars**. Given 181 days later: **nothing**.
- Hepatitis B Three-Dose Series, dose 1 recorded from another provider, dose 2 given 60 days later: **5.00 dollars**. Given 61 days later: **nothing**.
